display_title: I Picked Up a Lamp Today
description:
The main character, Kwak Chung, who was an orphan from birth and was born in Chengdu, suffered from polio as a child and was disabled in one leg. He sold rice cakes to merchants returning from the West for a living while being ignored by all kinds of uncomfortable bodies, and one day on his way home, he accidentally picked up a lamp. He rubbed it a few times because he thought it would make money if he sold it.

*"I will grant you three wishes, my lord."* A wish-fulfilling Genie appeared.

*"Are you sure you'll grant all your wishes?"*

Kwak Chung's first wish is money, not just money, but also enormous wealth such as silver, gold, silk, and jewelry. His second wish is to change into a tall, strong built, handsome and strong man. And the third wish is...

*"Let me go back to before I met you."*

That's how Kwak Chung's infinite return journey begins!
